4. The defendant No. 2 contested the suit by filing written statement contending, inter alia, that the suit was not maintainable in its present form, the suit was barred by limitation and the same was hit by section 42 of the Specific Relief Act; that the plaintiff was absent on different dates without the permission of the authority and for that he was asked to show cause but he failed to provide satisfactory reply; that when the government benefit was returned then the plaintiff became furious with the authority and threatened the defendant No. 2; that the enquiry committee was constituted in accordance with law and on their recommendation the plaintiff was dismissed from the service on 26-11-1991 effective from 6-12-1990 and that the plaintiff filed the suit with the ulterior motive when the Hon'ble Prime Minister declared the College as a Government one and, as such the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 b) Whether the suit was barred by limitation?
